subject: [RFC PATCH v2 15/18] mm/filemap: don't store f_ra.prev_pos for FMODE_RANDOM files

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the filemap_read function to skip storing f_ra.prev_pos for files that have FMODE_RANDOM set, which is used by applications like RocksDB to read files at random offsets from multiple threads. The patch addresses a performance issue where reads were slower due to unnecessary shared store operations. It keeps the slow path of the function intact and only skips the store operation when filemap_read_rcu has already done a full read without folio references.
